name: au-director-penalties
description: Use this guide to prepare the evidence on an Australian company director's personal liability for director penalties under Division 269 of Schedule 1 to the Taxation Administration Act 1953, on the law at 2 November 2026 (2026-27). Covers unpaid PAYG withholding, GST and super guarantee charge, including the Payday Super rules for QE days from 1 July 2026 and the saved rules for earlier quarters, ATO estimates, director penalty notices, the 21-day remission window, lockdown, new and resigned directors, parallel liabilities and the statutory defences. Trigger on 'director penalty notice', 'DPN', 'locked down DPN', 'director personally liable' or 'Division 269'.
